mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, symbol, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, created_at FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, account_id, symbol, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, created_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, account_id, symbol, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, executed_price, status, idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{orderType}, #{quantity}, #{limitPrice}, #{executedPrice}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt})
